entities.name: Thomas de Foix-Lescun
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Thomas de Foix-Lescun, commonly known as Lescun, was a French commander during the Italian War of 1521, and the brother of Odet de Foix, Vicomte de Lautrec, André de Foix, Lord of Lesparre and Françoise de Foix.
